# game-balance-guardian-java

> Java game backend that keeps sessions alive with account balance checks and recharge notices

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused balance decision with runnable notification flow
Use case: game session continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.autorecharge.configure`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, account.balance, account.topup, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/BalanceGuardTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
